name: PartnerStack
description: PartnerStack partnerships, customers, rewards and transactions with rate limiting, attribution and human-approved writes.

backend.description: mock keeps everything in memory (default); http calls PartnerStack.

baseUrl.description: Vendor API base URL. Default https://api.partnerstack.com/api/v2

authMode.description: basic (Vendor API, default) or bearer (Partner API).

publicKey.description: Basic auth username. Falls back to PARTNERSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY.

secretKey.description: Basic auth password. Falls back to PARTNERSTACK_SECRET_KEY.

apiKey.description: Bearer token. Falls back to PARTNERSTACK_API_KEY.

maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Local pace in any rolling 60 seconds, well under the documented 4000 per minute per IP. Default 600.

dailyCallBudget.description: Daily call cap for this gateway. The docs publish no number; default 5000 is an assumption.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Deadline for one HTTP request. Default 15000.

maxWriteCents.description: Largest reward or transaction amount an agent may create, in cents. Default 100000.

allowedTargets.description: Reward target types agents may create. Default customer and transaction, never manual.

approvalTimeoutMs.description: How long a money write waits for a human decision before it is denied. Default 120000.

inflightWindowMs.description: How long a sent-but-unconfirmed write is reported as in flight rather than unresolved. Neither is ever re-sent automatically. Default 60000.

ledgerDir.description: Directory for the append-only ledger and the daily budget counter. Default <OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR>/partnerstack.

permissionsPath.description: Passed to the policy seam (openclaw-policy-core). Default config/permissions.json.

usersPath.description: Passed to the policy seam (openclaw-policy-core). Default config/users.json.
